observed_policy.384_padding: All cases add seven pages: one DATA and six INDEX leaves. Hints rebase; index-owned additions remain represented.
observed_policy.700_padding_Legacy: Adds nine pages: one DATA, six INDEX leaves and two index-owned bitmap pages. The emptied ordinary hint rebases.
observed_policy.700_padding_Modern_and_Binary: Adds ten pages: one DATA, one ordinary-hint bitmap, six INDEX leaves and two index-owned bitmaps. The lower hint is retained.
observed_policy.inline_rules: Already represented additions retain their current base. Outside the current window, align the minimum down to eight and shift only if the inclusive span is less than 512; otherwise promote to indirect.
observed_policy.not_observed: No index-owned inline rebase, second bitmap window, global-map growth, INSERT or arbitrary old free-page reuse.
observed_policy.bitmap_membership: All 16 new bitmap pages are globally allocated but belong to no ordinary or physical-index owned map.
observed_policy.counter_contract: All 120 physical 12-byte counter blocks, known historical count fields and all table row counts remain exactly unchanged. Unexpected deltas would fail proof rather than extend permission.
observed_policy.membership_scope: 28 inventoried user/global roles per case; no complete foreign/historical semantic census or global database-health certification.
observed_policy.index_image_boundary: Public KEY-prefix choices/scratch and actual allocation order are observations, not native candidate full-key/ROW/residue goldens.
